text_content:
attackComplexityType
type: string
enum: HIGH, LOW

attackRequirementsType
type: string
enum: NONE, PRESENT

attackVectorType
type: string
enum: NETWORK, ADJACENT, LOCAL, PHYSICAL

automatableType
type: string
enum: NO, YES, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

ciaRequirementType
type: string
enum: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

criticalScoreType
type: number
maximum: 10
minimum: 9
multipleOf: 0.1

exploitMaturityType
type: string
enum: UNREPORTED, PROOF_OF_CONCEPT, ATTACKED, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

lowScoreType
type: number
maximum: 3.9
minimum: 0.1
multipleOf: 0.1

mediumScoreType
type: number
maximum: 6.9
minimum: 4
multipleOf: 0.1

modifiedAttackComplexityType
type: string
enum: HIGH, LOW, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

modifiedAttackRequirementsType
type: string
enum: NONE, PRESENT, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

modifiedAttackVectorType
type: string
enum: NETWORK, ADJACENT, LOCAL, PHYSICAL, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

modifiedPrivilegesRequiredType
type: string
enum: HIGH, LOW, NONE, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

modifiedSubCType
type: string
enum: NEGLIGIBLE, LOW, HIGH, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

modifiedSubIaType
type: string
enum: NEGLIGIBLE, LOW, HIGH, SAFETY, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

modifiedUserInteractionType
type: string
enum: NONE, PASSIVE, ACTIVE, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

modifiedVulnCiaType
type: string
enum: NONE, LOW, HIGH, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

privilegesRequiredType
type: string
enum: HIGH, LOW, NONE

providerUrgencyType
type: string
enum: CLEAR, GREEN, AMBER, RED, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

recoveryType
type: string
enum: AUTOMATIC, USER, IRRECOVERABLE, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

safetyType
type: string
enum: NEGLIGIBLE, PRESENT, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

subCiaType
type: string
enum: NONE, LOW, HIGH

userInteractionType
type: string
enum: NONE, PASSIVE, ACTIVE

valueDensityType
type: string
enum: DIFFUSE, CONCENTRATED, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

vulnCiaType
type: string
enum: NONE, LOW, HIGH

vulnerabilityResponseEffortType
type: string
enum: LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, NOT_DEFINED
default: NOT_DEFINED

version
description: CVSS Version
type: string
enum: 4.0

allOf[0]
anyOf[0].properties.baseScore.$ref: #/$defs/noneScoreType
anyOf[0].properties.baseSeverity.$ref: #/$defs/noneSeverityType
anyOf[1].properties.baseScore.$ref: #/$defs/lowScoreType
anyOf[1].properties.baseSeverity.$ref: #/$defs/lowSeverityType
anyOf[2].properties.baseScore.$ref: #/$defs/mediumScoreType
anyOf[2].properties.baseSeverity.$ref: #/$defs/mediumSeverityType
anyOf[3].properties.baseScore.$ref: #/$defs/highScoreType
anyOf[3].properties.baseSeverity.$ref: #/$defs/highSeverityType
anyOf[4].properties.baseScore.$ref: #/$defs/criticalScoreType
anyOf[4].properties.baseSeverity.$ref: #/$defs/criticalSeverityType
